kind: Kimi explicit Run native-final-text free prototype

mechanism.firstRoundBinding: Host freezes mode/Run/delivery and empty dedicated session root with offset 0 before launch; native session ID and exact wire path are bound at first fake-provider request before any response bytes. CLI chooses ID; not claimed known prelaunch.
mechanism.continuationBinding: Exact original session/path and prelaunch byte offset plus SHA256 of immutable prefix; no timestamp-based selection of publication evidence.
mechanism.usageExtraction: Existing parser receives only new byte suffix; timestamps are secondary usage filtering, not final authority.
mechanism.publication: After successful native exit and complete verified step/tool/end evidence, Host calls unchanged authenticated bound Worker bridge; receipt success authorizes Activation completion. No model receipt injected.
mechanism.sessionDiagnosticTrust: Version-pinned local wire is not cryptographically authenticated; no general stdout-to-message rule.

tests.note: final.test is imported by kernel.test, so its 11 cases execute twice; 20 distinct cases.

retainedAttempts.result: initial two-round pass; before additional actual CLI forbidden-read and memory-policy evidence

limits: Fake provider correctness is deterministic transport evidence, not real-model reliability or efficiency.
No paid test, no native-control cost comparison, no token savings or price claim.
Only two business turns and a narrow file tool workload.
Original byte suffix and native wire are private; no thinking text or credentials published.
First-round binding occurs after process startup but before provider response, unlike continuation prelaunch exact-session binding.
Uses previous private bound Worker bridge, not new repository native-text trial helper; no production capability or contract change.
